description: This file contains PHP classes that compile the 'while' and '/while' tags for the Smarty templating engine, including methods for parsing, compiling, and handling conditional logic in templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_While
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {while} tag in Smarty templates, translating it into executable PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for starting a 'while' loop based on provided conditions and attributes.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Whileclose
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {/while} closing tag in Smarty templates, properly closing the generated PHP loop.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to close a 'while' loop.
